event:TransactionsList.transactionSelect.summary: Fired when a row is activated (click, or the `selectRow` API). `id` is the transaction id in `transactions` mode, the `transferId` in `transfers` mode, or the history row id of the change in `formFields` mode. `createdAt` (ms, transactions mode only) is the row's partition hint — bind it into `TransactionView`'s `createdAt` so the view reads one partition instead of scanning the last ~12 months. Emitted in every `rowClickAction` — it is the page's own click handling under `event`.

event:TransferView.actorOpened.summary: An actor a leg names was pressed (a form-field leg's moved actors too). The app already shows it in a modal; bind this only to hear about it, not to navigate.

event:TransferView.repeat.summary: Repeat was pressed; the create-transaction form is opening, prefilled with every leg.

event:TransferView.transactionOpened.summary: A leg's «Open transaction» was pressed — route to a transaction view. `createdAt` (ms) is that transaction's partition hint.

event:Triggers.triggerAttached.summary: An existing trigger was attached to the target.

event:Triggers.triggerCreated.summary: A new trigger was created and attached to the target.

event:Triggers.triggerUnlinked.summary: A trigger was unlinked from the target (the trigger itself stays in the workspace).

event:Triggers.triggerUpdated.summary: A trigger's configuration was saved — it changes everywhere the trigger is attached.

event:Upload.onChange.summary: Fires when files are added, removed or retried; `$event` is the whole new file list — an array of `{ uid, name, size, type, status, progress?, error?, … }`, with files that failed `accept`/`maxSize` included as errors — which the page must write back to `fileList`.

event:Webhooks.webhookCreated.summary: Fires when a new webhook has been saved from the create dialog.
event:Webhooks.webhookCreated.body: `$event` carries its `id`, target `url` and the `actions` it is subscribed to.

event:Webhooks.webhookDeleted.summary: Fires when a webhook has been deleted; `$event.id` is the deleted webhook's id.

event:Webhooks.webhookUpdated.summary: Fires when changes to an existing webhook have been saved.
event:Webhooks.webhookUpdated.body: `$event` carries its `id` and its new `url` and `actions`.

event:WorkspaceSwitcher.switched.summary: Fired when the active workspace changes.

issue:route.ambiguousPath.title: Ambiguous paths
issue:route.ambiguousPath.summary: Two routes put different parameters at the same place, so an address could match either.
issue:route.ambiguousPath.body: Make the paths differ by a literal segment before the parameter, for example `/orders/:id` and `/users/:id` instead of `/:order` and `/:user`.

issue:route.duplicateName.title: Duplicate route name
issue:route.duplicateName.summary: Two routes of this Smart Form share a name; a name must be unique across all its pages.
issue:route.duplicateName.body: Rename one of them — `navigate.route` finds a route by its name alone.

issue:route.duplicateParam.title: Repeated parameter
issue:route.duplicateParam.summary: The same `:param` appears twice in one path, so the address could not say which value is which.
issue:route.duplicateParam.body: Give the second one its own name.

issue:route.duplicatePath.title: Duplicate path
issue:route.duplicatePath.summary: Two routes have the same path, so one address would open two pages.

issue:route.invalidName.title: Invalid route name
issue:route.invalidName.summary: The route name does not follow the grammar: dot-separated lowercase parts, each starting with a letter.
issue:route.invalidName.body: Use letters, digits and single hyphens, like `orders`, `graph.layer` or `sales-report.detail` — at most 64 characters.

issue:route.invalidParamDefinition.title: Inconsistent parameter
issue:route.invalidParamDefinition.summary: A parameter's declaration is inconsistent — an `actor` lookup on a parameter that is not a `slug`.
issue:route.invalidParamDefinition.body: Make the parameter a `slug`, or drop the `actor` lookup.

issue:route.invalidParamName.title: Invalid parameter name
issue:route.invalidParamName.summary: A `:param` name breaks the grammar: it must start with a letter and contain only letters and digits.
issue:route.invalidParamName.body: Rename it, for example `:actorId` rather than `:actor-id`.

issue:route.invalidParamValue.title: Parameter value does not fit
issue:route.invalidParamValue.summary: A parameter's value does not fit its type, or a navigation passes a parameter the route does not have.
issue:route.invalidParamValue.body: An `int` takes a whole number without leading zeros, a `slug` lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, a `uuid` a UUID. Check what the expression in `navigate.route.params` produces.

issue:route.invalidPath.title: Invalid route path
issue:route.invalidPath.summary: The path breaks the pattern grammar.
issue:route.invalidPath.body: It must start with `/` and be `/` alone or `/`-separated segments: lowercase-slug literals (`orders`) and `:param` placeholders. No empty or dot segments, no trailing `/`.

issue:route.pathLimit.title: Path too long
issue:route.pathLimit.summary: The path is over the limits: at most 16 segments, 128 characters a segment, 2048 characters in all.
issue:route.pathLimit.body: Shorten the path or move detail into the query.

issue:route.reservedSegment.title: Reserved path segment
issue:route.reservedSegment.summary: A path segment starts with `__`, which is reserved for the platform's own addresses.
issue:route.reservedSegment.body: Rename the segment so it does not start with two underscores.

issue:route.undeclaredParam.title: Undeclared parameter
issue:route.undeclaredParam.summary: A `:param` in the path has no declaration in `params`, or a navigation passes a parameter the route does not have.
issue:route.undeclaredParam.body: Declare it in the route's `params` with its type (`int`, `slug` or `uuid`), or remove it from the path or the action.

issue:route.unknownName.title: Unknown route
issue:route.unknownName.summary: A navigation names a route this Smart Form does not declare.
issue:route.unknownName.body: Pick a route that exists, or add the route to a page's `routes`. A develop page has no route table at all — preview it on a published release.

issue:route.unusedParam.title: Unused parameter
issue:route.unusedParam.summary: A parameter is declared in `params`, but the path has no `:param` for it.
issue:route.unusedParam.body: Add `:<name>` to the path, or remove the declaration.

issue:schema.additionalProperties.title: Unknown key
issue:schema.additionalProperties.summary: This key is not part of the contract — usually a typo or a prop the component does not have.
issue:schema.additionalProperties.body: Check the spelling against the component's reference, or remove the key. Save-time checks are strict, so an unknown key blocks saving.

issue:schema.const.title: Fixed value expected
issue:schema.const.summary: This place takes exactly one value, and something else is written here.
issue:schema.const.body: Use the value the contract names — for an action, its `type` decides which other keys are allowed.

issue:schema.enum.title: Value not allowed
issue:schema.enum.summary: The value is not one of those the contract allows here.
issue:schema.enum.body: Pick one of the allowed values — the field's ⓘ lists them — or switch the field to a `{{ }}` expression.

issue:schema.maximum.title: Number too large
issue:schema.maximum.summary: The number is above the largest value allowed here — `delay.ms` stops at 5000, for example.

issue:schema.minItems.title: List too short
issue:schema.minItems.summary: The list has fewer items than the contract requires — a JSON Patch needs at least one op, for example.

issue:schema.minimum.title: Number too small
issue:schema.minimum.summary: The number is below the smallest value allowed here.

issue:schema.oneOf.title: Matches no allowed shape
issue:schema.oneOf.summary: The value fits none of the shapes allowed here — for an action, usually a parameter that belongs to another action type.
issue:schema.oneOf.body: Check the action's `type` first, then its parameters against that type.

issue:schema.pattern.title: Wrong format
issue:schema.pattern.summary: The text does not match the format the contract requires — an identifier, an event reference or a route pattern, for example.
issue:schema.pattern.body: Compare it with the field's hint; identifiers use letters, digits, `_` and `-` and start with a letter or `_`.

issue:schema.required.title: Required value missing
issue:schema.required.summary: A value the contract requires is missing here, so sim-api would refuse to save the page.
issue:schema.required.body: Add it — the Inspector marks required fields with `*`.

issue:schema.type.title: Wrong kind of value
issue:schema.type.summary: The value is of the wrong kind — text where a number or a list is expected, for example.
issue:schema.type.body: Write the value in the expected type, or use a `{{ }}` expression, which any non-string prop accepts.

node:$ref.summary: Replaces this node with a reusable subtree from `definitions/<name>`.
node:$ref.body: The server inlines it before the page renders.

node:actions.summary: Event name (`onClick`) → the action chain it runs.
node:actions.body: Only the events the component declares are wired. Inside the chain `$event` is what the component passed.

node:children.summary: Child nodes: a list, or named slots when the component declares them.

node:for.summary: Renders this node once per item of an array.
node:for.body: `items` produces the array, `as` names the item (`$<as>`), `keyBy` picks the key field and `indexAs` names the position. Loop variables are visible in this node and its subtree only.

node:id.summary: The node's id: what `widget.call`, `$block.<id>` and bindings address.
node:id.body: A plain identifier, never an expression. Inside a `for` the renderer renames each copy `<id>:<key>`, so a block in a loop cannot be targeted by a binding.

node:if.summary: Mounts the node only while this condition is truthy.
node:if.body: JSONata, bare or in `{{ }}`. When falsy the node and its subtree are not mounted at all — use `visibility: "hidden"` to keep their state.

node:props.summary: The component's props. Any value may be a `{{ }}` expression.
node:props.body: Validated against the type's contract when the page is saved, not when it renders.

node:slot.summary: Which named slot of the parent this node goes into.

node:type.summary: The component this node renders — one of the catalog types.
node:type.body: An unknown type renders the renderer's fallback and is refused by sim-api at save.

node:variant.summary: A variant name for the component, when its contract defines one.

node:visibility.summary: Shows, hides or disables the node: `visible`, `hidden`, `disabled`, or an expression resolving to one.
node:visibility.body: Bare or in `{{ }}`, like `if`. The three literals stay literals; any other result is `visible`. `hidden` keeps the node mounted (its state survives the toggle); `if` unmounts it.

page:bindings.summary: Page-level rules: when a block emits an event, run an action chain.
page:bindings.body: Each rule is `{ on, when?, do }`. A primitive wires its own events in its `actions`; a binding is how the page reacts to a block.

page:description.summary: A note about the page for its authors. It is stored but never sent to the page.

page:id.summary: Page id. Keep it equal to the containing folder name (not enforced); page/render returns it as pageId.

page:meta.summary: Settings for how the page is served and for tooling — not part of what it shows.
page:meta.body: `initViaCorezoid`, `vmKeys` and `routeState` change what `page/render` returns; `tags`, `author` and `deprecated` are for tooling only.

page:meta.author.summary: Who maintains the page. For tooling; not sent to the page.

page:meta.deprecated.summary: Marks the page as deprecated for tooling. Not sent to the page.

page:meta.initViaCorezoid.summary: `true` makes `page/render` call the form's Corezoid process (`/get`) to seed the view model.
page:meta.initViaCorezoid.body: Without it the page starts from the `viewModel` file alone.

page:meta.routeState.summary: View-model keys the host mirrors into the URL so they survive reload/back-forward and can be shared as a link. Dot paths; the initial viewModel value is the default and is omitted from the URL. Only string/number/boolean values travel. Echoed by page/render as routeState.

page:meta.tags.summary: Free-form labels for tooling. Not sent to the page.

page:meta.vmKeys.summary: Optional allowlist of top-level view-model keys page/render keeps. Omitted = no filtering; a present array (including []) drops every other key, so [] ships an empty view model.

page:routes.summary: Short URLs that open this page: `/sf/{appKey}{path}`.
page:routes.body: Optional. Names must be unique and patterns must not overlap across the pages of a Smart Form; sim-api checks the whole table when a release is published and reports `route.*` codes.

page:routes.name.summary: Namespaced route name, unique within the Smart Form (e.g. graph.layer).

page:routes.params.summary: One declaration per :param of path, keyed by parameter name.

page:routes.path.summary: Pattern relative to /sf/{appKey}: '/' or '/'-separated lowercase-slug literals and :param segments, no trailing '/'.

page:schemaVersion.summary: Major.Minor. Author '2.0'. page/render echoes it; nothing checks or migrates it.

page:title.summary: The page title, sent to the host by `page/render` when it is not empty.

page:tree.summary: The root node of the page — everything the page shows grows from it.

prop:AccountDetails.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:AccountDetails.accountType.summary: The side the panel OPENS on; the reader (or `setAccountType`) may change it.

prop:AccountDetails.actorId.summary: The actor whose pair this is. Without an actor, a name and a currency the panel shows «select an account».

prop:AccountDetails.canEdit.summary: The viewer may edit the formula. A formula is a chip in the panel that opens the formula editor, read-only unless the page grants this; a blocked pair is read-only regardless. It edits or removes a formula the pair already has — it does not add one: a pair without a formula has no chip, and adding one is the ActorAccounts block's «Add formula» action.

prop:AccountDetails.currencyId.summary: The pair's currency id — a number, as the platform stores it.

prop:AccountDetails.formulaLabels.summary: Per-key copy overrides for the formula editor a chip opens — its own `accountFormula.*` keys, prefix included. The editor is another block, so `labels` cannot reach its strings.

prop:AccountDetails.labels.summary: Per-key copy overrides. Every string the block renders is a key here, which is the seam a page binds `{{ $locale.… }}` to — without it a page could not localize this block at all.

prop:AccountDetails.presentation.summary: Where the panel lives. `modal` renders NOTHING until `open` is called; `embedded` composes the panel into the page tree and starts open. Same split, same words as `CreateTransaction`. Read once, when the block mounts: it picks the initial open state, and changing it later does not re-open or close the panel.

prop:AccountTemplate.accId.summary: Workspace id; falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:AccountTemplate.formId.summary: Existing form id. Omit to create a new template.

prop:AccountTemplate.hideSaveBar.summary: Hides the footer with the Save button and the problem summary.
prop:AccountTemplate.hideSaveBar.body:
Use it when the page saves through the `save` api from its own button.

Default: `false`.

prop:AccountTemplate.labels.summary: Per-message overrides; explicit keys make each binding discoverable in the CDU editor.

prop:AccountTemplate.parentId.summary: Parent patch for create/update. Null explicitly detaches during edit.

prop:AccountTemplate.readOnly.summary: Shows the template without letting the user change it.
prop:AccountTemplate.readOnly.body:
The block is also read-only whenever the server does not allow saving this template.

Default: `false`.

prop:AccountTemplate.showBack.summary: Show the editor’s native return button; emits `back` for the containing page.

prop:AccountTemplate.tab.summary: Initial/deep-linked surface: `constructor` (Form fields), `preview`, `accounts` (the numeric accounts every actor of the template gets), `hierarchy` (the tree of templates nested under the same root, this one marked) or `access` (who may see and edit the template, or its actors — the block route `access/actors` opens the latter).
prop:AccountTemplate.tab.body:
On a new template the accounts and access tabs stage their changes, applied together with
its creation.

prop:AccountTemplatesList.accountId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:AccountTemplatesList.allowCreate.summary: Offer the toolbar's «Create Account Template» (opens the AccountTemplate block). Never shown for `scope: 'system'`. Off for a read-only page.

prop:AccountTemplatesList.exportQueueLin.summary: Offer «Open» on «Added to the export queue»; pressing it emits `exportQueueOpened`, which the page binds to wherever it shows Import & Export. Off by default: without a binding it would lead nowhere.

prop:AccountTemplatesList.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides, keyed by the block's own ids (`accountTemplatesList.*`).

prop:AccountTemplatesList.scope.summary: Which kinds of form the block may show — narrows its tabs.

prop:AccountTemplatesList.selectable.summary: Row checkboxes and the bulk bar (export queue, access, remove).

prop:AccountTemplatesList.tab.summary: The tab to open on; ignored when `scope` does not offer it.

prop:ActorAccounts.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:ActorAccounts.actorId.summary: Whose accounts to show. Without it the block has nothing to read.

prop:ActorAccounts.actorTitle.summary: That actor's name, when the page already has it. The tab never renders it — it hands it to the transaction form, whose actor field would otherwise resolve the name itself.

prop:ActorAccounts.canCreate.summary: Legacy switch for intercepting creation: `true` acts as `createHandling: 'event'`.

prop:ActorAccounts.canEdit.summary: Whether the reader may change anything: the create CTA and the row actions («Manage access»), and in «Form fields» the template actions («New form field», «Edit field», «Remove field»), which also need the reader's right to the template. The page owns this, because the privilege belongs to the actor and this block does not read access rules.

prop:ActorAccounts.createHandling.summary: WHERE creation happens. `embedded` (the default): the block opens its own create-account dialog. `event`: the page intercepts — the CTA emits `createRequested` and the page opens whatever it has. Declared rather than inferred: the bus cannot tell a block whether anyone is listening, and an enabled button whose event goes nowhere is the exact failure this block avoids everywhere else.

prop:ActorAccounts.fillHeight.summary: Stretch to the height the parent gives, scrolling rows under a sticky header.

prop:ActorAccounts.initialFolderId.summary: Open straight into one folder instead of the root — a TAG ACTOR id, the literal `untagged` for the bucket of pairs filed under no tag, `formFields` for the list of the actor's forms, or `formFields:<formId>` for one form's fields with their values. This is the INITIAL folder only; the block owns where it is afterwards and reports moves through `folderChanged`.

prop:ActorAccounts.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`actorAccounts.*`) — the seam a page localizes through, e.g. `{ "actorAccounts.crumb.root": "{{ $locale.accountsTitle }}" }`.

prop:ActorAccounts.surface.summary: Density. `panel` is the ~560px column of `actor-view`, which renders cards.

prop:ActorFilterEditor.accId.summary: Workspace the filter lives in. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:ActorFilterEditor.actorId.summary: The saved filter an embedded editor is on — re-binding it switches the editor; absent ⇒ a new filter. `openEdit` names its own.

prop:ActorFilterEditor.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry is optional and falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language — `{ "labels": { "save": "{{ $locale.saveFilter }}" } }`. Mirrors `ActorFilterEditorLabels`.

prop:ActorFilterEditor.pinAsTab.summary: Star a NEW filter in the packet that creates it, so it is a tab the moment it exists.

prop:ActorFilterEditor.presentation.summary: Overlay is the block's own dialog; embedded renders the editor in page flow. Defaults to `'modal'`.

prop:ActorList.accId.summary: Workspace id whose actors are listed. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:ActorList.allowCreate.summary: Offer the toolbar's «Create actor» (opens the CreateActor block on the list's Account Template, or with none when the list is not narrowed to one; a list pinned to the Scripts system form by `formTitle` offers «Create smart form», the CreateSmartForm wizard, instead, and one pinned to Graphs offers «Create graph», which makes a graph with its first layer at once — no dialog — and emits `actorCreated` for it). Off for a read-only page.

prop:ActorList.dataFilter.summary: Pin the list to actors whose `data.<key>` holds one of the listed values, e.g. only v2 smart forms: `{ "cduVersion": [2, "2"] }`. A number never matches its string spelling, so list both when writers disagree. Not a user-visible filter (no chip); search keeps to the pinned set, and saved filters with stored conditions are not offered as tabs.

prop:ActorList.defaultPageSize.summary: Rows per page; `ActorListApp` defaults it to 20. `.optional()`, not `.default()` — no Zod parse runs on the render path, and `gen-cdu-schema.mjs` refuses a zod default.

prop:ActorList.defaultTabId.summary: Tab id the list opens on. Matches one of the preset tab ids.

prop:ActorList.defaultVisibleColumns.summary: Seeds the initial "Columns" visibility. Omitted keys stay visible; the toolbar's Columns picker still lets a user toggle anything.

prop:ActorList.exportQueueLink.summary: Offer «Open» on «Added to the export queue»; pressing it emits `exportQueueOpened`, which the page binds to wherever it shows Import & Export. Off by default: without a binding it would lead nowhere.

prop:ActorList.formId.summary: Pin the list to one Account Template. Omit = all forms.

prop:ActorList.formTitle.summary: Pin to a system form by title (e.g. "Graphs"), resolved via `form/system/list`. Ignored when `formId` is set.

prop:ActorList.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry is optional and falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language, so a page localizes one string by binding it — `{ "labels": { "actorList.search.placeholder": "{{ $locale.searchActors }}" } }`.

prop:ActorList.rowActions.summary: The page's own items in each row's actions menu, before the built-in ones — ActorView's `header.actions` shape, serializable: choosing one emits `rowAction` and the page binds what it does (open the smart form in production, start a process, …). `icon` is a kit icon name. Not offered on the Trash tab: a deleted actor has nothing to act on.

prop:ActorList.rowClickAction.summary: What a single click on a row does. `panel` (the default) opens the actor beside the list, as legacy's actor list does; `drill` replaces the list with the actor's page until Back; `event` opens nothing, so the page handles the click itself by binding `actorClick`. `actorClick` is emitted in every mode; a Trash row never opens anything.

prop:ActorList.rowDoubleClickAction.summary: The same for a double click; `drill` by default — legacy opened the actor's own page. Set `event` when the page binds `actorDoubleClick` itself (e.g. to open a smart-form editor).

prop:ActorList.selectable.summary: Shows row-selection checkboxes and the bulk-action bar.

prop:ActorView.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:ActorView.activeSection.summary: The section to open. This is the INITIAL section only unless the page keeps updating it — the block owns where it is afterwards and reports moves through `sectionChanged`. A section that is not a tab on this surface (Info on a page) falls back rather than leaving the shell with no body.

prop:ActorView.activeTabId.summary: The tab to show, controlled by the page: the block shows it and reports the user's choices through `onTabChange`.
prop:ActorView.activeTabId.body:
Set it only when the page updates it from `onTabChange`, or the user cannot switch tabs. An id
that is not a tab on this surface shows Details.

prop:ActorView.actorId.summary: The actor to open. Without it the block has nothing to read.

prop:ActorView.backLabel.summary: Accessible text for the native Back control; defaults to actorView.header.back.

prop:ActorView.closable.summary: Whether the header offers a close button — a panel has something to close to.

prop:ActorView.context.summary: The context sections: `information` (metadata), `access` (who can see the actor) and `relations` (linked actors), plus the opt-in meeting sections `agenda` and `transcription`.
prop:ActorView.context.body:
On a wide page they form a right-hand column, on a narrow page one Context tab; on a panel
information joins Details and the other two become tabs of their own. Set a section to
`false` to hide it; `previewLimit` caps how many people or links are listed before "more"
(10 people, 5 links by default), and `relations.pageSize` sets how many links load at a time.

prop:ActorView.defaultActiveTabId.summary: The tab to open first when the page does not control `activeTabId`. Defaults to `activeSection`, then `details`.

prop:ActorView.details.summary: The Details tab, which every actor has; each part can be configured or turned off with `false`.
prop:ActorView.details.body:
`dates` is the date chip (start, else creation, and end); `description` the rich-text
description (`editable`, text-area `props`); `properties` the actor's form fields; `cards` the
linked card actor's fields (`expandable`); `smartForms` the smart form attached to the actor,
when it has one.

prop:ActorView.detailsTab.summary: `false` drops the Details tab — a chat's panel opens on its conversation.

prop:ActorView.fileBase.summary: Origin the platform's files are served from; absent resolves the transport's own.

prop:ActorView.header.summary: The header row: title, avatar, star, History and the actions menu.
prop:ActorView.header.body:
`editableTitle` and `editableAvatar` (both on by default) let a user with the modify right
rename the actor and change its picture in place; `favorite: false` hides the star;
`actorUrl` (an `http(s)` link) enables "Copy link"; `history: false` removes History, and
`pinHistory: false` keeps it only in the menu. `actions` adds the page's own commands: the one
with `placement: 'primary'` is a header button, the rest go to the menu, and choosing one
fires `onAction`. An action with `disabled` or `reason` (shown as its tooltip) cannot be
chosen, and its `error` shows as a banner under the header.

prop:ActorView.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`actorView.*`).

prop:ActorView.reactions.summary: The comments feed under the details, with its composer. `false` hides it; `props` configures the feed.

prop:ActorView.showBack.summary: Show native Back beside the avatar; emits backRequested for the page leave guard.

prop:ActorView.surface.summary: Density and layout. `page` has a right-hand column; `panel` has none, and the sections that would live in that column become tabs there instead.

prop:ActorView.tabs.summary: Extra tabs after Details, in order, each of a `kind`: `custom`, `attachments`, `accounts`, `forms`, `meeting`, `transcription` or `agenda`.
prop:ActorView.tabs.body:
A `custom` tab shows the node's named child slot `contentSlot`; `attachments` lists the actor's
files and `accounts` its accounts, each with optional `props`. Every tab needs a `title` and a
unique `id` other than `details`, `context`, `access` and `relations`; a misconfigured list
shows an error instead of the actor. Meeting is visible only for Events with a configured LiveKit URL,
and always stays mounted after its first visit. `transcription` is visible for Events while a call runs and stays once seen. Omit tabs for the default Meeting and Transcript tabs; [] hides them. A tab with `retention: 'keep-mounted'` stays mounted once
visited; leaving any other tab while there are unsaved changes asks the user first.

prop:Attachments.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:Attachments.actorId.summary: Whose files to show. Omit `actorId` for the workspace-wide page; give it for one actor, which also enables the "Reaction files" sub-tab and the "Download all" archive.

prop:Attachments.canEdit.summary: Whether the reader may upload, rename, detach or delete. The page owns this, because the privilege belongs to the actor and this block does not read access rules.

prop:Attachments.fileBase.summary: Files origin. Omitted, the block reads the transport's own API origin — right on every stand, where the app and the API are different hosts. `''` forces same-origin.

prop:Attachments.fillHeight.summary: Stretch to the height the parent gives, scrolling rows under a sticky header.

prop:Attachments.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`attachments.*`) — the seam a page localizes through, e.g. `{ "attachments.title": "{{ $locale.filesTitle }}" }`.

prop:Attachments.pageSize.summary: Rows per request. The server's hard maximum is 100 — `limit` above it is rejected outright rather than clamped, so this `.max()` turns a page-authoring mistake into a validation message instead of the block's error state.

prop:Attachments.selectable.summary: Whether row checkboxes and the bulk bar are offered.

prop:Attachments.surface.summary: Density and where the actions live. `panel` drops the Size and Owner columns.

prop:Avatar.badge.summary: Serializable badge overlay descriptor. The badge's enum/scalar fields flow from the component's `badge` type (`Omit<BadgeProps, 'size'>`); its icon is an icon-registry name stand-in (the adapter resolves it), and the non-serializable `BaseComponentProps` members are deliberately dropped.

prop:Avatar.disableInitials.summary: Skip initials extraction and show value as-is When true, displays the full value text without processing Useful for numbers, special characters, or short text like "+3", "99+"

prop:Avatar.shape.summary: Shape of the avatar — a round avatar (people) or a rounded-square tile (useful for event-type / category glyphs).

prop:Avatar.src.summary: Source URL for image avatar When provided, renders as image avatar (highest priority)

prop:Avatar.value.summary: Value to display (initials, text, or alt text for image) Used as fallback content, initials, or image alt text

prop:Avatar.variant.summary: Semantic status colour for the tile background (behind an icon or initials).

prop:AvatarGroup.max.summary: Maximum number of avatars to display before showing overflow indicator

prop:AvatarGroup.size.summary: Size of all avatars in the group

prop:Badge.dot.summary: Render as a small dot (status indicator) with no content. Ignores `value`, `icon` and children.

prop:Badge.pulse.summary: Show an animated attention ring (live indicator). Automatically disabled when the user prefers reduced motion.

prop:Badge.value.summary: Value to display in count badges (number or short text) Not used for dot badges

prop:Banner.variant.summary: Variant of the banner (determines icon and colors)

prop:Bleed.direction.summary: Direction to apply the negative margin - 'horizontal': Applies negative margin to left and right - 'vertical': Applies negative margin to top and bottom - 'all': Applies negative margin to all sides

prop:Bleed.space.summary: The size of the negative margin to apply Should typically match the padding of the parent container

prop:Breadcrumbs.items.summary: Stand-in for `items`: name-based descriptors (icon by name, no `onClick`).

prop:Breadcrumbs.itemsAfterCollapse.summary: Items to show after collapse button when maxItems is set

prop:Breadcrumbs.itemsBeforeCollapse.summary: Items to show before collapse button when maxItems is set

prop:Breadcrumbs.maxItems.summary: Maximum number of items to show before collapsing

prop:Button.ariaLabel.summary: Accessible name — REQUIRED for icon-only buttons (no `title` text).

prop:Button.expandIcon.summary: Expand icon direction to display after endIcon Shows ArrowUp2Icon when 'up' or ArrowDown2Icon when 'down'

prop:Button.fullWidth.summary: Whether the button should take full width

prop:Button.loading.summary: Whether the button is in a loading state

prop:CallTranscription.accId.summary: Workspace id; defaults to the host's active workspace.

prop:CallTranscription.active.summary: Whether the surface is visible; a hidden one holds reads back.

prop:CallTranscription.canComment.summary: Show the composer: a comment from the call, mirrored into the transcript.

prop:CallTranscription.labels.summary: Per-message copy overrides (`callTranscription.*` keys), bindable to `$locale`.

prop:CallTranscription.mode.summary: `full` — a page or a tab; `compact` — a narrow aside.

prop:Card.accent.summary: Leading accent bar in a semantic status colour. Wins the border over identityHue when both are set — see that prop's own doc comment.

prop:Card.arrowPlacement.summary: Arrow placement relative to the card If provided, displays an arrow pointing in the specified direction

prop:Card.backgroundColor.summary: Background color of the card — semantic tokens only (e.g., 'surfaceSubtle', 'surfaceSuccess', 'surfaceInverse', 'background') Overrides variant-specific background colors

prop:Card.color.summary: Text color for the card content — semantic tokens only (e.g., 'text', 'textStrong', 'textSecondary', 'foreground') Children elements will inherit this color Overrides variant-specific text colors

prop:Card.customSize.summary: Custom padding sizes for each side using CSS shorthand syntax When customSize is provided, size prop is ignored for padding

prop:Card.fontSize.summary: Font size for the card content Children elements will inherit this size

prop:Card.fullHeight.summary: Whether the card should take full height

prop:Card.fullWidth.summary: Whether the card should take full width

prop:Card.interactive.summary: Make the card behave as a clickable control: pointer cursor, hover/active surfaces, and full keyboard support. When set, the card renders with `role="button"`, is focusable, and activates on Enter/Space. Provide `onClick` to handle activation.

prop:Card.selected.summary: Selected/active visual state (primary tint + border). When the card is `interactive`, this is also reflected as `aria-pressed`.

prop:Card.squareCorner.summary: Removes the radius from one corner while preserving the card's other radii. Useful for directional surfaces such as incoming and outgoing message bubbles.

prop:Card.surface.summary: Navigation chrome adopts a theme's control material; content keeps its ordinary surface.

prop:Card.title.summary: Optional title displayed at the top of the card with underline

prop:Card.variant.summary: Visual variant of the card. `control` provides a contrasting boundary and field surface for composite inputs.

prop:ChangeJournal.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:ChangeJournal.avatarPath.summary: Avatar URL template the host already knows (`config/get().avatarPath`). Absent, the block reads it itself. A user avatar is templated, never stored on a history row.

prop:ChangeJournal.fields.summary: EXTRA choices for the Field filter, on top of the object kind's own model fields (which the block knows from sim-api's `e_history.ActorHistoryFields`). What a page adds here are the object's FORM fields — the half no block can discover. Each `label` is user-visible copy, which is why it is declared here: a page cannot localize a string the block does not expose.

prop:ChangeJournal.fileBase.summary: Origin the platform's files are served from, for picture and attachment previews. A stored `picture` is a fileName, not a URL, and on a deployed stand the app and the API are different hosts.

prop:ChangeJournal.fileViewerLabels.summary: Text overrides for the file viewer that opens when a picture or attachment in the feed is previewed.
prop:ChangeJournal.fileViewerLabels.body:
Keyed by the viewer's label names (`close`, `previous`, `next`, `download`, `copyLink`, …);
any key left out keeps the viewer's text for the active language.

prop:ChangeJournal.filterAppearance.summary: Filter controls: filled for plain surfaces, outline for tinted panels.

prop:ChangeJournal.initialFrom.summary: Overrides on the opening window, in milliseconds — most usefully a wider range than the default month ending on the object's update day. `from`/`to` are required by `history/*`, so there is no "unfiltered" state to open in.

prop:ChangeJournal.initialTo.summary: End of the opening window, in milliseconds.
prop:ChangeJournal.initialTo.body: Omitted, the window ends on the day of the object's last recorded change.

prop:ChangeJournal.labels.summary: Per-key copy overrides, including action summaries.

prop:ChangeJournal.locale.summary: BCP-47 tag for dates and times.

prop:ChangeJournal.mode.summary: Only change history is in scope. Legacy reaction history is intentionally not migrated.

prop:ChangeJournal.objId.summary: Object id whose history is shown.

prop:ChangeJournal.objType.summary: Object kind whose history is shown.

prop:ChangeJournal.pageSize.summary: Rows per request. The server caps this at 50.

prop:Chart.accId.summary: Workspace id. Omit to use the active workspace from the block host.

prop:Chart.actions.summary: The chart's own actions menu — Export to PNG, Export to CSV, Copy image. `inline` shows it at the end of the chart's controls row; `hidden` removes it, for a page that offers these through its own controls (the `downloadPng` / `downloadCsv` / `copyImage` api).

prop:Chart.actorId.summary: Actor of the Dashboards system form.

prop:Chart.drillDown.summary: What a click on a metric opens. `transactions` lists the transactions that formed the clicked value in a dialog over the chart. `none` only emits `metricClick`, for a page that handles the click itself (the older `?openDefaultModal=false` behaviour). `metricClick` is emitted either way. `min`/`max`/`avg` metrics never open a list.

prop:Chart.transactionsLabels.summary: Copy overrides for the drill-down's transaction list, keyed by the list's own message ids, e.g. `{ "transactionsList.col.amount": "{{ $locale.amountLabel }}" }`.

prop:ChatWidget.labels.summary: Overrides for every ChatWidget label; supports $locale bindings.

prop:ChatWidget.reactionsLabels.summary: Reactions copy overrides, including composer, actions and empty states.

prop:ChatWidget.widgetRef.summary: Reference of a Widgets system-form actor in the active workspace.

prop:Checkbox.error.summary: Whether the checkbox has an error state

prop:Checkbox.value.summary: Whether the checkbox is checked (controlled by value prop)

prop:Chip.endIcon.summary: Icon after the text, by its `@simulator-ui-kit/icons` export name; an unknown name shows no icon.

prop:Chip.startIcon.summary: Icon before the text, by its `@simulator-ui-kit/icons` export name (`"StarIcon"`); an unknown name shows no icon.

prop:Col.minHeight.summary: Allow shrinking below the content's intrinsic height by setting `min-height: 0`. Required for a nested scroll area inside a flex column.

prop:Col.minWidth.summary: Allow shrinking below the content's intrinsic width by setting `min-width: 0`. Required to let a flex child truncate its own children (e.g. an ellipsised Label inside a row).

prop:Col.offset.summary: Number of columns to offset from the left

prop:Col.pull.summary: Number of columns to pull to the left

prop:Col.push.summary: Number of columns to push to the right

prop:ColorPalette.accId.summary: Workspace whose saved colours to use. Omitted ⇒ the host's active workspace, which is what a page normally wants; naming one is for a page that deliberately shows another's.

prop:ColorPalette.clearable.summary: Offer a "no colour" well that clears the choice.

prop:ColorPalette.hues.summary: Which theme hues to offer in the Default row, by contract name (`violet`, `blue`, …). Omitted ⇒ every hue, in the contract's order.

prop:ColorPalette.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides. Every entry is optional and falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language, so a page localizes a single string by binding it — `{ "labels": { "custom": "{{ $locale.myColours }}" } }` — without restating the rest. Mirrors `ColorPaletteLabels`.

prop:ColorPalette.value.summary: The chosen colour, as `#rrggbb`. Bound by the page to whatever is being coloured.

prop:ColorPicker.value.summary: Current color value in hex format (#RRGGBBAA)

prop:CreateAccount.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:CreateAccount.actorId.summary: The actor the account is created on. Without it the dialog has nothing to write to.

prop:CreateAccount.initialTag.summary: The tag folder the dialog was opened from — the new account is pre-filed under it.

prop:CreateAccount.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`createAccount.*`) — the seam a page localizes through, e.g. `{ "createAccount.title": "{{ $locale.newAccount }}" }`.

prop:CreateAccount.offerAccess.summary: Show the access step (`block-sharing` over the new pair) after the save.

prop:CreateAccount.presentation.summary: Overlay is host-owned (`modal`, the default); `embedded` renders the panel in page flow.

prop:CreateAccount.showTriggers.summary: Show the Triggers field (hide on a server without `account/triggers/update`).

prop:CreateActor.accId.summary: Workspace id the actor is created in. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:CreateActor.actorId.summary: Existing actor to edit. Takes precedence over `formId`.

prop:CreateActor.formId.summary: The template to create from. Absent ⇒ an embedded Account Template picker is shown first.

prop:CreateActor.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry is optional and falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language, so a page localizes one string by binding it — `{ "labels": { "createActor": "{{ $locale.createActorCta }}" } }`. Mirrors `CreateActorLabels`.

prop:CreateActor.layerId.summary: Sets the actor's default title only (sim-api's `contextLayerId`) — cosmetic, not a scope.

prop:CreateActor.presentation.summary: Overlay is host-owned; embedded renders the same application directly in page flow. The adapter defaults it to `'modal'` (`.optional()`, not `.default()`: no Zod parse runs on render).

prop:CreateEvent.accId.summary: Workspace id the event actor is created in. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:CreateEvent.actorId.summary: Existing event actor to edit. Absent ⇒ create mode.

prop:CreateEvent.capabilities.summary: Per-capability override, merged over the defaults (all `false` until backend support lands).

prop:CreateEvent.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; each key falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language.

prop:CreateEvent.ownerUserId.summary: Seeds the owner's own full-privilege access-rule grant at create time. Required with no host-derived default — the host services layer doesn't expose current-user identity yet, so a page must bind this from wherever it tracks the logged-in user today.

prop:CreateSmartForm.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:CreateSmartForm.corezoid.summary: The empty form's Corezoid switch when the dialog opens; other templates are locked on. Off for a reader without the import permission whatever this says.

prop:CreateSmartForm.defaultTemplate.summary: The template picked when the dialog opens (`application/template/list` ids: `empty`, `basic`); one the server does not offer falls back to `empty`.

prop:CreateSmartForm.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`createSmartForm.*`) — the seam a page localizes through, e.g. `{ "createSmartForm.title": "{{ $locale.newForm }}" }`.

prop:CreateSmartForm.presentation.summary: Overlay is host-owned (`modal`, the default); `embedded` renders the panel in page flow.

prop:CreateTransaction.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialAccount.summary: The account name + currency to open on. One pair serves both modes: in transfer mode the source's debit and the destination's credit are both derived from it, which is what makes "every leg shares one currency" true by construction.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialActorId.summary: Transaction mode: the actor to open on.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialActorTitle.summary: That actor's name, when the page already has it — the field then needs no `actor/get` to label the selection. Purely an optimisation: without it the block resolves the name itself.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialComment.summary: The comment the form opens with, in any mode; empty by default.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialDirection.summary: Transaction mode: the direction to open on.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialFieldTrans.summary: Form-field mode: the source actor and the recipients the form opens with, each optionally on a field (`formId` + `fieldId`). Values are never seeded: the form offers what the source holds when it opens.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialFromActorI.summary: Transfer mode: the source actor (money leaves its DEBIT account).

prop:CreateTransaction.initialFromActorT.summary: Transfer mode: those actors' names, when the page has them — each spares its leg's field an `actor/get`. Optimisation only, like `initialActorTitle`.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialMode.summary: Mode the block OPENS in; the user (or `switchMode`) may change it.

prop:CreateTransaction.initialToActorId.summary: Transfer mode: the destination actor (money arrives at its CREDIT account).

prop:CreateTransaction.initialToActorTit.summary: Transfer mode: the destination actor's name, when the page already has it.
prop:CreateTransaction.initialToActorTit.body: Used only together with `initialToActorId`; without it the block resolves the name itself.

prop:CreateTransaction.labels.summary: Per-key copy overrides. Every string the block renders is a key here, which is the seam a page binds `{{ $locale.… }}` to — without it a page could not localize this block at all.

prop:CreateTransaction.locked.summary: Pin the actor and the direction, leaving only the amount and comment editable.
prop:CreateTransaction.locked.body:
This is legacy's repeat-a-transaction entry point: `useTransactionsActions.js`
opens the modal with `id: transaction.id` alongside the actor, account, direction and
amount, and `data.id` is what disables the actor picker and the direction there. The
other opener (`ActorAccountMenu.js`) passes the same context WITHOUT an id and stays
editable — pre-filling and pinning are deliberately separate. It never meant "edit":
that modal had no update path at all.

prop:CreateTransaction.presentation.summary: Where the form lives. `modal` renders NOTHING until `open` is called; `embedded` composes the form into the page tree and starts open. Same split, same words as `CreateActor`.

prop:DashboardWizard.accId.summary: Workspace id the dashboard belongs to. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:DatePicker.labels.summary: Custom labels for buttons and select fields. Use to localize the component or override default English text. Unspecified keys fall back to their English defaults.

prop:DatePicker.locale.summary: Locale for month and weekday names (BCP 47 language tag). Accepts both full tags (`"en-US"`, `"uk-UA"`) and short tags (`"en"`, `"fr"`). Short tags are automatically expanded via `Intl.Locale.maximize()` for week start detection. Defaults to the active `LocaleProvider` language, or `'en'` without a provider.

prop:DatePicker.mode.summary: Selection mode. - `'single'` — picks one date (startDate === endDate in the emitted value) - `'range'` — picks a start and end date

prop:DatePicker.recurrence.summary: Whether to show the Repeat section below the calendar — an on/off toggle that reveals frequency, interval, weekday and occurrence-count controls.
prop:DatePicker.recurrence.body: Opt-in: with this off (the default) the panel renders exactly as before and the emitted value carries no `recurrence` key at all. With it on, the rule is committed alongside the date by the OK button as DatePickerValue.recurrence, and is `null` while the toggle is off.

prop:DatePicker.showTime.summary: Whether to show time picker (hours and minutes)

prop:DatePicker.showTimezone.summary: Whether to show timezone selector (only available when showTime is true)

prop:DatePicker.size.summary: Size of the date picker. Controls the density of the always-open calendar panel (cell and header sizes), not a row-control height — the DatePicker is a panel and does not sit on the shared control scale.

prop:DatePicker.use12Hours.summary: Use 12-hour time format with an AM/PM column (only available when showTime is true)

prop:DatePicker.weekStart.summary: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday. If omitted, auto-detected from `locale` via `Intl.Locale.getWeekInfo()` / `weekInfo`. Falls back to 1 (Monday, ISO standard) if the browser does not support week info.

prop:Divider.color.summary: Color of the divider from the design system palette

prop:Divider.size.summary: Size of the divider (affects text size and spacing)

prop:Divider.textPosition.summary: Text position when divider contains text

prop:DragDropZone.accept.summary: Accepted file types (MIME types or file extensions) Only applies when enableFileInput is true

prop:DragDropZone.enableFileInput.summary: Whether to enable file input integration When true, clicking the zone will open file picker

prop:DragDropZone.fileInputAriaLabel.summary: ARIA label for file input Only applies when enableFileInput is true

prop:DragDropZone.multiple.summary: Whether to allow multiple file selection Only applies when enableFileInput is true

prop:ESign.accId.summary: Workspace id. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:ESign.actorId.summary: The actor whose document is signed — the `ds` reaction's root actor.

prop:ESign.documentId.summary: The document's id, echoed in the events when the archive's own id is not known. sim-api signs the actor's archive (its summary PDF zipped with its attachments), shared by every signer.

prop:ESign.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry falls back to the kit dictionary.

prop:ESign.presentation.summary: What the block draws: `button` (default) — the sign button showing the signature's state; `chip` — the e-signatures queue chip; `none` — nothing until signing, for a page that starts it from any of its own components through `startSign`. The loader and the widget show in all three.

prop:EventsCalendar.accId.summary: Workspace whose events are shown. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:EventsCalendar.allowCreate.summary: Offer creating events (the toolbar's «New event», a day's «+», a selected slot).

prop:EventsCalendar.date.summary: The day the calendar opens on, unix seconds. A seed: the reader navigates from it and a new value moves the calendar there — bind it to route-backed state that `rangeChanged` sets from `$event.date` to restore the period from the address.

prop:EventsCalendar.defaultView.summary: The view the calendar opens with: `month`, `week`, `day` or `agenda`. Defaults to the month, or the agenda in a narrow container.

prop:EventsCalendar.includeChats.summary: Show chats too. Off by default: a chat has no schedule.

prop:EventsCalendar.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by `eventsCalendar.*` — the seam a page localizes through.

prop:EventsCalendar.memberIds.summary: "Meet with": only events these users take part in.

prop:EventsCalendar.ownerIds.summary: Only events owned by these users.

prop:EventsCalendar.rowClickAction.summary: What opening an event does: beside the calendar (`panel`), instead of it (`drill`), or nothing — the page handles `eventOpened` (`event`).

prop:EventsCalendar.showFilters.summary: Offer the Filters popover — stream, "Meet with", chats.

prop:EventsCalendar.showSidebar.summary: The mini month beside the calendar on a wide container.

prop:EventsCalendar.stream.summary: A system Events stream (`all`, `sign`, `ds`, `execute`, `starred`, `meetings`, …) or a custom stream's actor id — bind it to a `Streams` block's `stream` state. Bound, the Filters popover offers no stream picker of its own.

prop:EventsCalendar.weekStart.summary: First day of the week: `0` Sunday, `1` Monday. From the language when omitted.

prop:EventsCalendar.workingHours.summary: Working hours shaded in the week and day views, in hours.

prop:EventsList.accId.summary: Workspace id whose events are listed. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:EventsList.allowCreate.summary: Offer the toolbar's «Add event» (opens the CreateEvent block). Off for a read-only page. The `compact` chat list has no «Add event»; conversations start from `Streams`.

prop:EventsList.defaultPageSize.summary: Rows per page the list opens with: `10`, `20`, `50` or `100`. The reader can change it.

prop:EventsList.density.summary: Compact event rows with activity previews; does not switch to the Chats stream.

prop:EventsList.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`eventsList.*`).
prop:EventsList.labels.body:
The seam a page localizes through, e.g.
`{ "eventsList.search.placeholder": "{{ $locale.searchEvents }}" }`; any key left out keeps
the kit text for the active language.

prop:EventsList.liveCallCard.summary: Where an event whose call is running shows as a call card — a preview of the call, who is in it, the last lines said, a message line, Chat, Details and Join — instead of a row: `live-streams` (the Live streams only), `always` (any feed) or `never`. The chat list never shows cards.

prop:EventsList.rowClickAction.summary: What opening a row does. `panel` shows it beside the list in the actor view, `drill` replaces the list with it until Back, `event` opens nothing so the page handles `eventSelected` itself (a page that lays out its own chat). Defaults by variant, as legacy did: `panel` for the `compact` chat list, `drill` for the feed. The opened event is kept in the block's route, so the address can be copied.

prop:EventsList.selectedEventId.summary: The event (chat) to paint as selected — e.g. the one a neighbouring chat block shows.

prop:EventsList.stream.summary: The stream the list shows. A system stream (`all`, `sign`, `ds`, `execute`, `starred`, `meetings`, `globalLive`, `liveMeetings`, `persistentMeetings`, `graphComments`; for chats `chats`, `p2p`, `group`) or a custom stream's actor id. With `streams` it is the one the bar opens on (a changed prop switches it; defaults to the kind's All) — bind it to the page's route-backed state that `streamChanged` sets, so the address restores it. Without, bind it to a `Streams` block's `stream` state; omitted, a `default` list shows the whole Events form and a `compact` one every chat.

prop:EventsList.streams.summary: Lay the streams bar over the list — the `Streams` block's bar (system and own streams, counts, Read all, mute, Manage streams and a new stream), composed by the list itself: the bar picks what the list shows, of the list's own kind, and a chat started from the contact book opens in the list. The picked stream is `state.stream` and `streamChanged`; `allowCreate` gates new streams and the chat search's compose action. Off, a page lays a `Streams` block over the list and binds the two itself.

prop:EventsList.variant.summary: `default` — the events feed; `compact` — the chat list (legacy's Chats screen): one dense row per chat under a search that stays inside the stream, no filters or sort.

prop:EventsList.view.summary: The feed as a `list` or as the events `calendar` (month, week, day, agenda), as legacy's events page switched. The chat list is always a list.

prop:EventsList.viewSwitch.summary: Show the List | Calendar switch above the feed; the reader's pick is `state.view` and `viewChanged`.

prop:Form.valueKey.summary: The vm key holding this form's values (default: the form id). Values live at `vm[valueKey]`.

prop:GraphEditor.accId.summary: Workspace id. Omit to use the page's active workspace.

prop:GraphEditor.actorId.summary: The entry point: the GRAPH actor (§4.4). A graph is an ordinary actor, and the actors linked to it by a `hierarchy` edge whose form is `Layers` are its layers — so this is what a page binds, and the block picks the layer.
prop:GraphEditor.actorId.body:
Legacy called it `graphFolderId`. Optional for a deep link: when absent, the
block-local route's graph id becomes the entry point.

prop:GraphEditor.coordinateGrid.summary: Show the coordinate rulers — the lettered/numbered bands that give every actor a spreadsheet-style address (`F, -4`). Defaults to `true`, mirroring legacy's `coordinateGrid` user setting; a page turns it off for an embedded/preview surface where the chrome would dominate.

prop:GraphEditor.debug.summary: Show the render-diagnostics panel — engine/present frame rates, the legacy-compatible current and average rates, frame-build cost, drawn and culled counts, and LOD tier.
prop:GraphEditor.debug.body:
Absent ⇒ the adapter falls back to the block bus's `dev` flag, so it is ON in
local development and OFF in a production build. A page sets it explicitly to
force either way, and because the generated schema widens booleans to accept an
expression, "on for the dev stand" can be authored as a binding rather than
hidden in a build: `"debug": "{{ $env != 'production' }}"`.

prop:GraphEditor.focusActorId.summary: Select and centre this actor after the target layer opens. The block route wins when present.

prop:GraphEditor.graph3d.summary: Enable the lazy read-only spatial overview. Absent means off in every environment.

prop:GraphEditor.graph3dFontUrl.summary: Same-origin font URL for Troika labels; omitted uses bounded DOM billboard labels.

prop:GraphEditor.layerId.summary: Deep link to ONE layer of that graph — a layer is an actor, so this is an actor id too. Optional, and it short-circuits the resolve.
prop:GraphEditor.layerId.body:
The block also carries a deep-linkable block-local route holding the same
thing, and the route wins when set, so a reload reopens the same layer
without resolving again (§10.3).

prop:GraphEditor.layerMenuLabels.summary: Active-layer menu copy overrides, for `{{ $locale.* }}` bindings.

prop:GraphEditor.onboardingLabels.summary: First-run editor-tour copy overrides, for `{{ $locale.* }}` bindings.

prop:GraphEditor.showBack.summary: Show the editor’s native return button; emits `back` for the containing page.

prop:GraphEditor.wholeSkeleton.summary: Also fetch the whole layer's skeleton once, after the first sector.
prop:GraphEditor.wholeSkeleton.body:
Off by default: it is the one read whose cost scales with the layer rather
than the viewport. Turn it on for a page that needs to know WHERE things
are without needing their data — a mini-map, an export, "centre on an actor
that has not been loaded yet".

prop:GraphEditor.zoomDive.summary: Fall into an actor by zooming into it — the `dive` experiment.
prop:GraphEditor.zoomDive.body:
Unlike `debug` this does NOT follow the bus's dev flag: absent means off everywhere, because it
changes what a gesture does rather than what the editor shows about itself. A stand that wants it
says so — `"zoomDive": true`.

prop:GuestJoin.hash.summary: The link's hash — the `/m/:hash` path segment.

prop:GuestJoin.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; each falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language.

prop:Icon.name.summary: Icon-registry name → resolved to `IconProps['component']` by the adapter.

prop:Icon.size.summary: Size of the icon. The named sizes resolve through the *spacing* scale (`md` → 20px); `inherit` sizes the glyph to `1em` so it tracks the surrounding text — the value for icons embedded in prose (`Link`, inline labels), where no fixed name is correct at more than one text size.

prop:Icon.tone.summary: Semantic colour of the icon, resolved to a theme token (class-based, zero runtime CSS). The only way to tint an icon — a raw colour would bypass the theme contract.

prop:Icon.type.summary: Type of the icon - determines fill/stroke behavior

prop:Image.alt.summary: Alternative text. Leave empty for a purely decorative image (the default), which marks it `alt=""` so assistive tech skips it.

prop:Image.fit.summary: How the image fills its box (CSS `object-fit`). Use `cover` for a full-bleed background (inside a `fill` layout container).

prop:Image.fullHeight.summary: Stretch to the container's full height (needed for a full-bleed layer).

prop:Image.fullWidth.summary: Stretch to the container's full width.

prop:Image.radius.summary: Corner rounding from the theme `borderRadius` scale.

prop:Image.src.summary: Image source — a URL or data URI. Required.

prop:ImportExport.accId.summary: Workspace whose tasks are listed. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:Label.color.summary: Color from the design system palette

prop:Label.error.summary: Whether the label is in an error state

prop:Label.grow.summary: Whether the label should grow to fill available space (flex: 1) Useful when the label is a child of a flex container and should take remaining space

prop:Label.lines.summary: Clamp the text to N lines with a trailing ellipsis (multi-line truncation). For single-line truncation use `overflow="cut"` instead. Mutually exclusive with `overflow` — `lines` wins if both are set.

prop:Label.maxWidth.summary: Maximum width of the label Useful for constraining label width and enabling text wrapping

prop:Label.overflow.summary: How to handle text overflow (single line): `cut` = ellipsis, `break` = wrap.

prop:Label.showTooltip.summary: Whether to show a tooltip with the label content on hover

prop:Label.text.summary: Text child rendered as the label's `children`.

prop:Label.title.summary: Custom title attribute for the span element

prop:Label.whiteSpace.summary: White space handling Controls how white space and line breaks are handled

prop:List.dataSource.summary: Opaque list items; the adapter's default renderer prints primitives / JSON-stringifies objects.

prop:List.divider.summary: Whether to show dividers between list items

prop:List.fullHeight.summary: Whether the component should take full height

prop:List.fullWidth.summary: Whether the component should take full width

prop:MeetingAgenda.accId.summary: Workspace id; defaults to the host's active workspace.

prop:MeetingAgenda.active.summary: Whether the surface is visible; a hidden one holds its read back.

prop:MeetingAgenda.canEdit.summary: Show the editor (the server requires `modify` for every write).

prop:MeetingAgenda.labels.summary: Per-message copy overrides (`meetingAgenda.*` keys), bindable to `$locale`.

prop:MeetingCallButton.accId.summary: Defaults to the host's active workspace.

prop:MeetingCallButton.actorId.summary: Existing Events actor; omitted means create a room for the recipients.

prop:MeetingCallButton.callTo.summary: meet/call/create.callTo — local user IDs, never SA/avatar IDs.

prop:MeetingCallButton.title.summary: Optional title of the new room.

prop:MeetingRoom.accId.summary: Workspace id; defaults to the host's active workspace.

prop:MeetingRoom.active.summary: Hidden panels retain the call while pausing their local preview.

prop:MeetingRoom.actorId.summary: Events actor used as the meeting room.

prop:MeetingRoom.autoJoin.summary: Explicitly join once on mount; microphone and camera default to off.

prop:MeetingRoom.guest.summary: Guest presentation; does not grant or replace server permissions.

prop:MeetingRoom.initialDevices.summary: Device choices, read only when the actor surface mounts.

prop:MeetingRoom.labels.summary: Per-message copy overrides (meetingRoom keys without the namespace), bindable to $locale.

prop:MeetingRoom.waitingRoomLabels.summary: Copy of the public link's waiting room hosts see beside the participants (publicLink keys without the namespace), bindable to $locale.

prop:Modal.contentPadding.summary: Padding around the content slot. Set to `none` when the child owns a complete panel layout with its own padded regions and edge-to-edge dividers.

prop:Modal.height.summary: Dialog height strategy. `viewport` keeps query-backed content at 70vh while `full` uses the complete 90vh dialog allowance. Both leave the content area responsible for scrolling.

prop:Modal.scrollable.summary: Whether to show scrollbar when content overflows

prop:Modal.size.summary: Modal size affecting width and content area

prop:NavMenu.items.summary: Stand-in for `items`: name-based descriptors (icon/badge icon by name).

prop:NavMenu.maxCollapseLevel.summary: Number of collapse levels before using popover

prop:NavMenu.popoverConfig.summary: Popover configuration for expandable menu items

prop:NavMenu.size.summary: Row target size, including icon-only rows.

prop:NavMenu.tooltips.summary: Hide hints when an enclosing panel already reveals labels on hover.

prop:NotificationCenter.accId.summary: The workspace whose feed is shown. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:NotificationCenter.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`notificationCenter.*`) — the seam a page localizes through, e.g. `{ "notificationCenter.title": "{{ $locale.news }}" }`.

prop:NotificationCenter.scope.summary: `workspace` — the workspace's feed; `all` — every workspace holding entries, read or not, one group each under its name, the active one first.

prop:NotificationCenter.variant.summary: `popover` — a bell with the unread count that opens the feed; `panel` — the feed laid out in the page.

prop:NotificationSettings.accId.summary: The workspace whose settings are shown — they are per workspace. Falls back to the active workspace from the host.

prop:NotificationSettings.defaultTab.summary: The tab open first: `general` — what notifies and how; `sound` — ringtone and sounds.

prop:NotificationSettings.labels.summary: Per-message text overrides keyed by this block's own message ids (`notificationSettings.*`, and `muteMenu.*` for the mute menu) — the seam a page localizes through, e.g. `{ "notificationSettings.title": "{{ $locale.notifications }}" }`.

prop:Notifications.position.summary: Position of the notification container on screen

prop:Notifications.width.summary: MAXIMUM width of the notification column — it hugs its content up to this, so a two-word toast is two words wide.

prop:Pagination.align.summary: Horizontal alignment of the pagination within its container.

prop:Pagination.current.summary: Currently active page (1-based). When provided the component is controlled; omit to use internal state.

prop:Pagination.pageSizeOptions.summary: Options available in the page-size changer.

prop:Pagination.showQuickJumper.summary: Whether to render the quick-jump TextInput.

prop:Pagination.showSizeChanger.summary: Whether to render the page-size changer Select.

prop:Pagination.siblingCount.summary: Number of page buttons to show on each side of the current page button.

prop:Pagination.size.summary: Size of the pagination controls, matched to the design system size scale.

prop:Pagination.total.summary: Total number of items to paginate.

prop:Pagination.type.summary: Layout variant. `default` renders numbered page buttons; `simple` renders a text input instead.

prop:Pagination.visibility.summary: Visibility state. `disabled` makes the entire control non-interactive.

prop:Popover.byClickPosition.summary: Open popover at click position (useful for context menus)

prop:Popover.hideDelay.summary: Delay in milliseconds before hiding the popover (for mouseover trigger)

prop:Popover.interactive.summary: Interactive popover - keeps popover open when moving cursor to content Only affects mouseover trigger behavior

prop:Popover.offset.summary: Distance in pixels between popover content and trigger element

prop:Popover.placement.summary: Placement of popover relative to trigger element If not provided, optimal placement will be calculated automatically

prop:Popover.showDelay.summary: Delay in milliseconds before showing the popover (for mouseover trigger)

prop:Popover.toggleOnRepeatedClick.summary: Toggle popover on repeated trigger clicks

prop:Popover.topLevel.summary: Render popover in document.body (top level) using portal
prop:Popover.topLevel.body:
- topLevel=true: Portal rendering (document.body) + respects updateStrategy prop
- topLevel=false: Inline rendering + always optimized (no scroll listeners)

Both use position: fixed. The main difference is portal vs inline rendering and scroll tracking. Use topLevel=false for better performance when scroll tracking is not needed. Use topLevel=true (default) for tooltips and context menus that need to track trigger element.

prop:Popover.updateStrategy.summary: Strategy for updating popover position - 'always': Updates position continuously during scroll (current behavior, good for context menus) - 'smart': Updates only when trigger goes out of viewport (better performance for dropdowns)

prop:ProgressBar.closeIcon.summary: Show close icon next to status

prop:ProgressBar.error.summary: Error state - changes progress bar color to error

prop:ProgressBar.percentage.summary: Show percentage text below the progress bar

prop:ProgressBar.statusText.summary: Status text to display (if provided, status section will be shown)

prop:Quote.backgroundColor.summary: Background color from the design system palette

prop:Quote.indicatorColor.summary: Indicator bar color from the design system palette

prop:Radio.error.summary: Whether the radio group has an error state

prop:Radio.options.summary: Radio options; each option's ReactNode label is narrowed to a string.

prop:Radio.variant.summary: Layout variant for the radio group

prop:Reactions.accId.summary: Workspace id; falls back to the active host workspace.

prop:Reactions.active.summary: Compact successful empty comments to their composer; loading/errors and existing comments remain visible.

prop:Reactions.composerActions.summary: Composer tools to expose. Omit to allow every tool available in this deployment.

prop:Reactions.composerCollapsible.summary: Start the new-comment composer as just its comment field; its tools show on focus or click.
prop:Reactions.composerCollapsible.body:
The tools also stay visible while a draft is in progress.

Default: `false`.

prop:Reactions.initialOrder.summary: Initial comment ordering; later user changes are persisted locally.

prop:Reactions.maxPages.summary: Maximum retained pages before opposite-edge eviction.

prop:Reactions.mode.summary: Messenger projection or threaded comment projection.

prop:Reactions.readOnly.summary: Hide every mutation affordance while retaining navigation and links.

prop:Reactions.rootActorId.summary: Actor whose reaction tree is displayed.

prop:Reactions.scrollMode.body:
`contained`: the feed scrolls inside its own box and never hands the scroll to the page.
`chained`: the feed scrolls inside its own box, and scrolling past its edge carries on into the
page. `parent`: the feed grows with its content and the nearest scrolling ancestor (or the
window) scrolls it.

Default: `'contained'`.

prop:Reactions.smartForms.summary: How a smart form attached to a reaction opens.
prop:Reactions.smartForms.body:
By default the smart form runs inside the comment: its title with an Open button, the form
below it once opened. `false` shows the title as a plain chip that opens nothing.
`{ props: { … } }` passes options to the smart form: `labels` and `active`.

prop:Row.grow.summary: Grow to fill the free space of a flex parent (`flex: 1 1 0%`).

prop:Row.gutter.summary: Spacing between columns. A single token sets horizontal spacing; a tuple sets `[horizontal, vertical]` spacing for wrapped rows.

prop:Row.minHeight.summary: Allow shrinking below the content's intrinsic height by setting `min-height: 0`. Required for a nested scroll area inside a flex column.

prop:Row.minWidth.summary: Allow shrinking below the content's intrinsic width by setting `min-width: 0`. Required to let a flex child truncate its own children (e.g. an ellipsised Label inside a row).

prop:Row.wrap.summary: Whether to wrap items to new lines

prop:SearchEntity.accId.summary: Workspace id to search. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:SearchEntity.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry is optional and falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language — `{ "labels": { "placeholder": "{{ $locale.placeholder }}" } }`.
prop:SearchEntity.labels.body:
A `record`, not a hand-listed key set: the authoritative list is `SearchEntityLabels` in
the block package, kept honest there by `SEARCH_ENTITY_LABEL_KEYS`'s `satisfies` check.
Unknown keys are ignored by `resolveLabels`, which walks that list rather than the payload.

prop:SearchEntity.types.summary: Allow-list of searchable types — the ONLY filter, a host/page configuration parameter. Omitted/empty = every type.

prop:Select.clearable.summary: Shows a clear button that resets the current selection

prop:Select.endIcon.summary: Trailing trigger icon, by icon-registry name (adapter-resolved).

prop:Select.expandIcon.summary: Expand icon direction to display instead of endIcon Shows ArrowUp2Icon when 'up' or ArrowDown2Icon when 'down' Takes priority over endIcon when provided

prop:Select.helperTooltip.summary: Tooltip text to display next to helper text

prop:Select.loading.summary: Whether the input is in a loading state Shows spinner instead of icons when true

prop:Select.maxHeight.summary: Maximum height of the dropdown list in pixels

prop:Select.maxTagCount.summary: Maximum number of selected-value tags rendered in the trigger before collapsing to a count

prop:Select.multiple.summary: Allows selecting more than one option at a time

prop:Select.noDataText.summary: Message shown in the dropdown when no options match the current search. Defaults to the kit dictionary — an empty panel must still say something, or it reads as a rendering bug rather than an answer.

prop:Select.options.summary: Options with each icon referenced by registry name (adapter-resolved).

prop:Select.searchable.summary: Enables searching. Where the user types is decided by searchPlacement.

prop:Select.startIcon.summary: Leading trigger icon, by icon-registry name (adapter-resolved).

prop:Select.value.summary: Currently selected value; pass an array when `multiple` is true

prop:Select.variant.summary: Visual variant controlling border and focus-ring color

prop:Select.virtualize.summary: Enables virtual scrolling for large option lists

prop:Select.virtualizeThreshold.summary: Minimum number of options required before virtual scrolling is activated

prop:SelectAccount.accId.summary: Workspace id whose account names / currencies are listed. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:SelectAccount.autoFocus.summary: Focus (open) the account-name field on mount.

prop:SelectAccount.disableSystemAccounts.summary: Render system names / currencies as disabled rows.

prop:SelectAccount.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry optional, falling back to the active language.

prop:SelectAccount.multiselect.summary: Accumulate multiple pairs (list + «Add») instead of a single pair.

prop:SelectAccountTemplate.accId.summary: Workspace id whose templates are listed. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:SelectAccountTemplate.allowAll.summary: Offer an «All Account Templates» scope row (for embedding as a filter).

prop:SelectAccountTemplate.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry is optional and falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language, so a page localizes one string by binding it — `{ "labels": { "title": "{{ $locale.templatesTitle }}" } }`. Mirrors `SelectAccountTemplateLabels`.

prop:SelectAccountTemplate.withParents.summary: Also fetch + report the picked Account Template's parent chain (`form/get { with:['parents'] }`).

prop:SelectActor.accId.summary: Workspace id whose actors are listed. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:SelectActor.allowCreate.summary: Show the "Create" affordance (needs a template scope).

prop:SelectActor.createSurfaces.summary: Per-template creation-surface overrides, keyed by form id — `{ "42": "companyCard" }`. Highest precedence in `resolveCreateSurface`, so a workspace can route one of its own templates at a bespoke surface without a code change.

prop:SelectActor.defaultFormId.summary: The template the picker OPENS in, which the user may still change.

prop:SelectActor.defaultSelectedId.summary: The actor the picker OPENS with — typically one the page restored from its URL (`routeState`), so a reload shows the choice the rest of the page is already using. Read once at mount, like `defaultFormId`: later changes are the `select` / `clear` api's job, so the selection keeps one owner. The title is fetched by id; no `picked` fires for it.

prop:SelectActor.excludeSystem.summary: Drop actors of system templates (chats, events) from the recent list.

prop:SelectActor.formId.summary: Pin the scope to one Account Template; the scope control is then not rendered.

prop:SelectActor.labels.summary: Per-label text overrides; every entry is optional and falls back to the kit dictionary for the active language, so a page localizes one string by binding it — `{ "labels": { "recent": "{{ $locale.recentActors }}" } }`. Mirrors `SelectActorLabels`.

prop:SelectActor.presentation.summary: `field` = full-width combobox; `inline` = compact trigger for a toolbar.

prop:SelectActor.systemFormTitle.summary: Pin the scope to one SYSTEM Account Template by its exact title (e.g. `"Dashboards"`), resolved through `form/system/get` — for a page that doesn't know the template's numeric id up front. Same pinning effect as `formId` (hides the scope control); ignored when `formId` is also supplied. Mirrors `SelectActorApp`'s own `systemFormTitle` prop exactly.

prop:SelectActorAccount.accId.summary: Workspace id whose accounts are read. Falls back to the active workspace.

prop:SelectActorAccount.actorId.summary: The actor whose accounts are offered. Absent ⇒ the field is inert and says so.

prop:SelectActorAccount.disableSystemAcc.summary: Show the actor's platform counters (`Incoming edges`, `Total reactions`, …) as disabled rows. Any page that moves money must set this — legacy's transaction modal does (`CreateTransaction.js:243`) — because a system counter is written by the platform, never by a manual transaction.

prop:SelectActorAccount.helperText.summary: Supporting or validation text under the field. This is where an `invalid` page puts its message: without it `invalid` is a red box with nothing saying what is wrong.

prop:SelectActorAccount.incomeType.summary: Which side's balance each option shows.
